format: start-up Anytime Fitness center (4,000 to 7,000 sq ft leased vanilla shell)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of an Anytime Fitness center is between $539,329 to $905,482. This includes $91,357 to $111,462 that must be paid to the franchisor or affiliate.

fee.quote: Our standard initial franchise fee for an Anytime Fitness center is $42,500.
fee.note: 1 location: existing franchisee $37,500, veteran $38,250, veteran existing $33,750, Club Purple $27,500, Club Platinum $22,500. Development Fee for 2 locations $75,000 (new franchisee). In 2025 fees ranged from $22,500 to $42,500.

royalty.basis: fixed monthly fee (franchisor may switch to up to 8% of Gross Revenue)
royalty.flat: Currently $842 per month per center. Monthly Fees are subject to an annual CPI increase in January each year.
royalty.quote: Monthly Fee Currently $842 per month per center. Monthly Fees are subject to an annual CPI increase in January each year. We reserve the right to replace this fixed fee with a percentage-based monthly royalty of up to 8% of Gross Revenue.

adFund.quote: General Advertising and Marketing Fee Currently, $900 per month per center, beginning when you open your center. ... it will not exceed the greater of $900 per month or 3% of Gross Revenue
adFund.note: Flat $900 per month (may rise to the greater of $900/month or 3% of Gross Revenue). Local Marketing Spend $600, $800 or $1,000 per month depending on market tier; Grand Opening and Ramp Up Program $11,000 to $23,000.

EBITDA is from 11 company-owned centers (9 in Illinois, 2 in Minnesota) with expenses adjusted to franchisee costs (royalty $10,104, ad fund $10,800, technology $9,588); excludes owner salary beyond a manager base salary, 401K, interest, taxes, D&A.

special: Royalty is a flat Monthly Fee ($842/month, CPI-indexed), not a percentage; franchisor may switch to up to 8% of Gross Revenue on 30 days' notice. Technology System package ($37,857 to $45,462) must be bought from affiliate ProVision, plus a $799/month Base Technology Fee rising 10% per year compounded. Club Enhancement Program of $1,000/month recommended for remodel at renewal.
issues: Item 7 does not state whether real estate is excluded (it includes 3 months' rent and security deposit for a leased space); excludesRealEstate left null. Fixed annual amounts computed as monthly x 12.
